officialReference.title: Autodesk MATERIAL (DXF)
officialReference.fieldsUsed: Groups 70/40 define ambient method/factor and groups 71/41 define diffuse method/factor. Methods are 0 or 1; factors default to 1.0 and have documented range 0.0 to 1.0.
officialReference.role: Normative DXF field/domain reference for this slice; no DWG byte layout changed.

method.limitations: Only ambient/diffuse method and factor fields are typed. Unsigned color values 90/91, map/mapper fields, remaining MATERIAL fields, and DWG body semantics remain unimplemented; raw-net DXF preservation is not typed semantic support.

implementation.behavior: Present values are retained independently from documented defaults and emitted by the typed writer, including explicit default-valued fields. Invalid methods/factors are refused; invalid factors do not replace an existing output file.
